# Clinical KB

> Private medical guideline RAG knowledge base.

This is a medical knowledge retrieval system containing authoritative clinical guidelines, pathways, and therapeutic references.

## Capabilities

- Advanced Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) for medical queries
- Evidence-based answers grounded in official sources
- Differential diagnosis comparisons
- Medical pathway extraction

## APIs and Tools

If you are an agent, you can interact with the Clinical KB via its structured API endpoints.
Please refer to the source codebase for detailed route specifications.
